name: Frasers Centrepoint Trust
summary: Frasers Centrepoint Trust (FCT) is a leading developer-sponsored retail real estate investment trust (REIT) with assets under management of approximately S8.4 billion dollars. As Singapore's only retail-focused REIT and largest suburban retail mall owner, FCT's portfolio comprises eight suburban malls that enjoy stable and recurring shopper footfall supported by commuter traffic and strong residential catchments. The Singapore retail portfolio has approximately 2.9 million square feet of net lettable area and over 1,700 leases, with a strong focus on necessity spending, food & beverage and essential services.
